language.title: Language
language.description: The primary language in which the document content is written, such as English, Spanish, French, or other ISO language codes.

documentNumber.title: Document Number
documentNumber.description: The unique identifier, reference number, or code assigned to the document, such as memorandum number, case number, contract ID, or policy number.

fileSummary.title: File Summary
fileSummary.description: A concise overview of the document's main content, purpose, and key points to provide quick understanding of the file.

contentType.title: Content Type
contentType.description: The classification or category of the document based on its purpose and structure, such as report, contract, policy, presentation, or correspondence.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: A comprehensive list of named entities in the document, including: (1) Persons – names of individuals such as employees, clients, and stakeholders; (2) Organizations – companies, agencies, departments, and institutions; (3) Locations – countries, cities, addresses, facilities, or venues; (4) Document References – IDs, policy numbers, contracts, case numbers, and citation codes; (5) Dates – event dates, deadlines, milestones, and historical references; (6) Financial Entities – monetary amounts, budget codes, accounts, invoices, and instruments; (7) Products – services, systems, software, equipment, or tools; (8) Legal Entities – statutes, regulations, laws, and codes; (9) Projects/Initiatives – names of programs, campaigns, or strategic efforts; (10) Technical Terms – acronyms, abbreviations, and domain-specific terminology; (11) Other significant entities relevant for understanding or retrieving the document.

recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.description: The intended recipient(s), addressee(s), or target audience for the document, such as specific individuals, teams, or departments.

confidentialityLevel.title: Confidentiality Level
confidentialityLevel.description: The security or confidentiality classification of the document, such as Public, Internal Use Only, Confidential, or Restricted.

documentStatus.title: Document Status
documentStatus.description: The current status or state of the document in its lifecycle, such as Draft, Under Review, Approved, Final, or Archived.

effectiveDate.title: Effective Date
effectiveDate.description: The date when the document becomes effective, valid, or active, in MM/DD/YYYY format.

expirationDate.title: Expiration Date
expirationDate.description: The date when the document expires, becomes invalid, or requires review or renewal, in MM/DD/YYYY format.

approver.title: Approver
approver.description: The name or identifier of the individual or authority who approved, authorized, or signed the document.

author.title: Author
author.description: The name or identifier of the individual, team, or organization responsible for creating or authoring the document.

createdDate.title: Created Date
createdDate.description: The date when the document was originally created or first saved, in MM/DD/YYYY format.

lastUpdated.title: Last Updated
lastUpdated.description: The date of the most recent modification or revision made to the document, in MM/DD/YYYY format.
